description: Competitions, creative challenges, and contest spotlights at DEF CON 22, including the X-Hour Film Contest and the Social Engineering Capture the Flag.

talks.title: X-Hour Film Contest: Xploit
talks.teaser: An original sci-fi short film conceived, shot, and edited in 48 hours during DEF CON 22 by TooSmartGuys for the X-Hour Film Contest.

talks.title: X-Hour Film Contest: They Live
talks.teaser: An original sci-fi short film created in 48 hours during DEF CON 22 by team Torchwood for the X-Hour Film Contest.

talks.title: X-Hour Film Contest Winner: Invasion of the Bboonians
talks.teaser: The winning short film from the DEF CON 22 X-Hour Film Contest, written, shot, and edited in 48 hours by team Uberlab.

talks.title: X-Hour Film Contest: Cosmic Burrito
talks.teaser: An original sci-fi short film produced over 48 hours during DEF CON 22 by team Tentative 3+2 for the X-Hour Film Contest.

talks.title: X-Hour Film Contest: Brian Knappenberger Announces Winner
talks.teaser: Documentary filmmaker Brian Knappenberger announces the winning entry and judges''' selections for the DEF CON 22 X-Hour Film Contest.

talks.title: Social Engineering Capture the Flag Contest Review
talks.teaser: Chris Hadnagy and Michelle Fisher review the methodology, rules, and scoring results of the Social Engineering Capture the Flag contest at DEF CON 22.

talks.title: FTC Zapping Rachel Robocall Contest Update
talks.teaser: FTC Commissioner Terrell McSweeny and Patricia Hsue share updates on the Zapping Rachel contest challenging hackers to build robocall blocking solutions.
